description: This PHP source file defines the 'ClaimExpense' entity class for the OrangeHRM application. It models claim expense data, including expense type, date, amount, notes, associated claim request, and deletion status. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: ClaimExpense
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim expense record, including properties for expense type, date, amount, notes, associated claim request, and deletion status, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the claim expense record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the claim expense record.

methods.name: getExpenseType
methods.description: Returns the ExpenseType associated with this claim expense.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Sets the ExpenseType for this claim expense.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the expense.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the expense.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the expense.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount of the expense.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns additional notes about the expense.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets additional notes about the expense.

methods.name: setClaimRequest
methods.description: Associates a ClaimRequest with this expense.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the expense has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense as deleted or not.
